{{Quote|A hunter-killer droid standing guard? Someone is serious about protecting the secrets of this place, Master.|[[Quinlan Vos/Legends|Quinlan Vos]] to [[Tholme/Legends|Tholme]]|<ref name="Star Wars (1998) 37">[[Star Wars (1998) 37|''Star Wars'' (1998) 37]]</ref>}}
The '''HKB-3 hunter-killer droid''' was a [[Battle droid/Legends|battle droid]] produced by [[Baktoid Combat Automata/Legends|Baktoid Combat Automata]] prior to the [[Invasion of Naboo/Legends|Invasion of Naboo]].

==Characteristics==
[[File:HunterKillers-SWREP37.jpg|thumb|left|200px|Nute Gunray's HKB-3 hunter-killers in action]]
HKB-3 droids were easily modified hunter-killer [[Droid/Legends|droids]]. They had square heads and were equipped with rapid-fire [[Blaster/Legends|blasters]]. They relied on a [[Central Control Computer/Legends|Central Control Computer]] to coordinate their operation. This feature made them effective at tracking a target because they could easily coordinate with each other when sent out in groups. Individually they had poor targeting abilities, but in a group, if one droid homed in on a target, all droids in the patrol group could coordinate their fire on the same coordinates to maximize their effectiveness.

==History==
Prior to and during the [[Stark Hyperspace War/Legends|Stark Hyperspace War]], HKB-3s were favored by officials of the [[Trade Federation/Legends|Trade Federation]] to serve as [[Bodyguard/Legends|bodyguards]] and provide general sentry duties. It was during that conflict that [[Wookiee/Legends|Wookiee]] [[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Master]] [[Tyvokka/Legends|Tyvokka]] was killed after [[Trade Federation Minister]] [[Nute Gunray/Legends|Nute Gunray]] ordered his hunter-killer droid bodyguards to "kill them all" when Tyvokka happened to be nearby.

By the time of [[Invasion of Naboo/Legends|Invasion of Naboo]], they had largely been replaced by the highly-superior [[Droideka/Legends|droideka]]. Though a rarer sight than the [[B-series battle droid/Legends|B-series battle droid]], HKB-3 hunter-killer droids could still be seen during the Clone Wars, typically relegated to simple guard duties or patrolling remote [[Planet/Legends|planets]].<ref name="SGtD" />
